WITH customer_recency AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        dateDiff(
            'month',
            MAX(DateKey),
            toDate('2009-12-31')
        ) AS months_since_last_purchase
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        months_since_last_purchase,
        CASE
            WHEN months_since_last_purchase <= 6  THEN 'Active'
            WHEN months_since_last_purchase <= 12 THEN 'At Risk'
            ELSE 'Churned'
        END AS recency_segment
    FROM customer_recency
)
SELECT
    recency_segment,
    count(CustomerKey)          AS customer_count,
    round(
        count(CustomerKey) * 100.0
        / nullif(sum(count(CustomerKey)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    )                           AS pct_of_total
FROM customer_segments
GROUP BY recency_segment
ORDER BY
    multiIf(
        recency_segment = 'Active',   1,
        recency_segment = 'At Risk',  2,
        3
    )
